findings.reason: The initial implementation calls os.sched_getaffinity(0) without handling an affinity lookup failure, which can abort fact collection rather than use nproc or the cpuinfo count. It also calls get_bin_path without catching its missing-binary ValueError; that latter defect was fixed at step 19, but the affinity failure remained.

The rewritten fallback correctly catches a missing nproc binary, but again uses hasattr(os, 'sched_getaffinity') followed by an unguarded call. If the affinity operation fails, get_cpu_facts raises instead of retaining or obtaining a usable CPU count.

The agent attempted to replace assertion strings containing comments that were not in the rewritten harness, then reran it unchanged. It failed at the identical line reported in step 47. Printing the actual fact or deriving it from the fixture before changing the assertion was a cheaper way to unblock the intended nproc checks.
